verdicts.question: Is the cable routing in the site photos continuous and consistent across the documented run — from rooftop panels to DCDB to inverter to ACDB to solar meter to main panel — with no orphan ends, no unexplained mid-run size changes, and visible conduit / cable-tie / clipping where the run is exposed?
verdicts.designer_notes: No designer answer for this target — the vision routine verifies it by tracing cables across photos with 'Cable Routing', 'Equipment Location', 'Meter Box' and similar captions on pages 4+.
verdicts.photo_observation: The Cable Routing Legend (page 4) defines color codes for PV array, meters, DC/AC cables, and earthing. Page 9's CAD diagram shows a purple AC-cable line running from the new panels through a rooftop 'Duct' label; the following real photo shows the same purple line continuing down the exterior wall near the AC condenser units and a door. Page 10 continues the purple line along the side-yard pathway to the meter box on the wall ('AC cable is already connected for the existing system'). Page 11-12 show the line arriving at the labeled Main Meter/Solar Meter compartments. Separately, page 12-15 trace an orange/green earthing route (LA and AC Earth Pit) along the same side-yard path to marked pit locations.
verdicts.rationale: The color-coded cable path is shown continuously across the CAD diagram and matching real photos from roof duct to meter panel, with no orphan segments or unexplained gaps; the route follows a wall-mounted duct/conduit consistent with the legend, though the very first mm-scale roof-to-duct connection point itself isn't shown in a close-up photo.
